name: ARCS Company Limited
summary: ARCS Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in retail business and related operations in Japan. The company operates 10 community-based food supermarkets and other general retail store chains. It is also involved in home improvement, building maintenance, insurance, non-life and life insurance agency business, industrial waste and general waste collection and transportation business, resource environment, and travel businesses. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.
